detail.longDescription: I started a Computer Engineering degree this year. I had already spent three years studying programming, but I took a break last year, and now I’m struggling I keep going blank and hitting a mental block. When I look at the requirements and the diagram, I have no idea what to do, where to start, or how to proceed. Sometimes I make some progress, but then I get stuck on how to structure things after struggling for a while, I end up asking an AI (though I try to avoid using it), and it provides a solution that never would have occurred to me. Please help could you share any tips on how you managed to get past a situation like this.
